## TotemAutomata 0.1.19

- Renders the selected Copper Golem gathering area through TotemCore's shared
  world-outline API.
- Uses terrain depth testing so opaque blocks hide occluded selection edges.
- Keeps source, destination, current-target and blocked-state particle cues.
- Requires TotemCore 0.7.13 or newer within the 0.7.x compatibility line.

Minecraft 26.2 · Fabric · Java 25
